title: Security Keys
description: A resource pack to turn the keycards from Security Craft into keys!
body:
[![alt text](https://www.bisecthosting.com/partners/custom-banners/aa8962f9-e6ff-4a83-8eeb-d145d3c55343.webp) ](https://bisecthosting.com/Zoni25)

This is a resource pack made in order to turn the keycards from Security Craft into keys.

In order for the pack to work you need to have [Security Craft](https://modrinth.com/mod/security-craft) installed.

The textures for the keys were made by [@Pixelahead](https://x.com/Pixelahead).

If you want to get updates on the pack development, report bugs or suggest new stuff or just contact me join my discord server:
https://discord.com/invite/KWGakdBVwG
